# Evan Lee Portfolio

> Evan Lee is a student at Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute pursuing a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (CSCI) and Game Simulation Arts and Science (GSAS), expected May 2028. His work spans platform engineering, Python automation, data validation, monitoring, Unity, and Roblox game systems.

## Selected work

- NAS Access Reporting Automation: Python/pandas workflow that joined NAS share, session, user, owner, and support-contact data into review-ready Excel reports.
- PvE Extraction Dungeon: Class-based Roblox dungeon crawler with server-authoritative combat, procedural rooms, persistent storage, loot loss, and extraction systems.
- Three-Level Unity Platformer: 2D Unity game with responsive movement, directional dashing, hazards, triggered platforms, persistent death tracking, and player feedback.
- Monopong: Unity arcade prototype with circular paddle movement, physics-based collisions, a three-life loop, particles, sound, and camera shake.
